Diminished Ovarian Reserve - Indicates a reduced quantity or quality of eggs in female patients.
Low Morphology - Indicates a low percentage of normally shaped sperm in male patients.
Severe Oligospermia - Indicates an extremely low sperm count in male patients.
Very Severe Male Factor - Indicates a significant male infertility issue.
Endometriosis - Indicates the presence of endometrial tissue outside the uterus in female patients.
Tubal Ligation - Indicates that the patient has undergone tubal ligation as a contraceptive method.
Hydrosalpinx - Indicates the presence of fluid in the fallopian tubes in female patients.
Communicating Hydrosalpinx - Indicates the presence of fluid in the fallopian tubes connected to the uterus in female patients.
Occluded Hydrosalpinx - Indicates the presence of fluid in the fallopian tubes with a blocked end in female patients.
Hydrosalpinx with Unknown Characteristics - Indicates hydrosalpinx with unspecified features in female patients.
Other Tubal Factor - Indicates other issues related to the fallopian tubes in female patients.
Ovulation Disorders - Indicates problems with ovulation in female patients.
Other Male Factor - Indicates other male infertility issues not specified elsewhere.
Premature Ovarian Failure - Indicates the loss of ovarian function before the age of 40 in female patients.
Turner Syndrome - Indicates the presence of Turner syndrome, a genetic disorder affecting females.
Other Diminished Ovarian Reserve - Indicates other issues related to diminished ovarian reserve in female patients.
Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) - Indicates the presence of PCOS, a hormonal disorder in female patients.
Hypothalamic Amenorrhea - Indicates the absence of menstruation due to a hypothalamic issue in female patients.
Other Ovulation Disorders - Indicates other issues related to ovulation disorders in female patients.
Oocyte or Embryo Banking - Indicates the preservation of eggs or embryos for future use.
Uterine Factor - Indicates issues related to the uterus in female patients.
Indication for the use of a gestational carrier (surrogate mother) to carry the pregnancy.
Absence of Uterus - Indicates the absence of the uterus in female patients.
Significant Uterine Anomaly - Indicates a significant abnormality in the uterus of female patients.
Medical Contraindication to Pregnancy - Indicates medical reasons that make pregnancy risky for the patient.
Gestational Carrier for Recurrent Pregnancy Loss - Indicates the use of a gestational carrier for patients with a history of recurrent pregnancy loss.
Gestational Carrier - Indicates the use of a gestational carrier, but the reason is unspecified.
Recurrent Pregnancy Loss - Indicates a history of multiple miscarriages in female patients.
Other Reason - Indicates other reasons not specified elsewhere.
Other Preimplantation Genetic Diagnosis (PGD) - Indicates other reasons for PGD not specified elsewhere.
Unexplained Infertility - Indicates infertility without a clear identifiable cause in the patient.
Other Non-Infertile Reason - Indicates other reasons for non-infertility not specified elsewhere.
